page.overview:
Who is Heart Pirates?

At least 3,000,001,5003,000,000,000Bepo - 1,500}} At least 500,000,500500,000,000Bepo - 500}} At least 440,000,500440,000,000Bepo - 500}} At least 200,000,500200,000,000Bepo - 500}}

The Heart Pirates are an infamous and notable rookie pirate crew from the North Blue and introduced on Sabaody Archipelago around the time the Straw Hat Pirates arrived there two years ago. Their captain, Trafalgar D. Water Law, is a member of the Worst Generation and a former member of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. They were in an alliance with the Straw Hat Pirates, Kouzuki Family, and Mink Tribe with the goal of taking down both Donquixote Doflamingo of the Seven Warlords of the Sea and Kaidou of the Four Emperors. The alliance was dissolved after their objective of taking down Doflamingo and Kaidou was achieved.

Following the events of Wano, the crew was attacked on Winner Island by the Blackbeard Pirates and were utterly defeated in the ensuing battle. Save for Law and Bepo, the fate of the crew is unknown.

Unlike many other pirates from the North Blue, the Heart Pirates do not use a skull and crossbones, but a smiley face instead. The Heart Pirates' Jolly Roger has protrusions in six directions and is in fact pretty similar to that of the Donquixote Pirates, without the cancel sign over it.
